name: What should I do immediately if my water heater is leaking?

mainEntity.name: What should I do immediately if my water heater is leaking?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you discover your water heater leaking, first turn off the water supply to the heater to prevent further water damage. Locate the cold water shut-off valve, usually on top of the unit. Next, turn off the power supply; for electric heaters, switch off the circuit breaker, and for gas heaters, turn the gas valve to the 'off' position. Then, contact a professional plumber for inspection and repair.
acceptedAnswer.description: Immediately turn off the water supply and the power (or gas) to your water heater. Then, contact a professional plumber for assistance.
